level.L1.name: L1 · Standard
level.L1.scene: Client needs color kept (charts, UI screenshots).
level.L2.name: L2 · Grayscale
level.L2.scene: Mostly B&W slides, code and text.
level.L3.name: L3 · High compression
level.L3.scene: Squeeze harder; some grain is acceptable.
level.L4.name: L4 · Smart (default)
level.L5.name: L5 · Minimal audio
level.L5.scene: Very low bandwidth (2G/3G); speech must stay intelligible.
level.L6.name: L6 · Long interval
level.L6.scene: Extreme compression; slower speech; visible frame steps.
level.L7.expected: Locked to target (e.g. 99 min → 8 MB, ~3 kbps video)
level.L7.name: L7 · Exact size (2-pass)
level.L7.scene: Output must be under a fixed size (MB).
level.L8.name: L8 · H.265 extreme
level.L8.scene: Modern players only (VLC/PotPlayer). H.265 compatibility risk.
scenario.archive.hint: Bulk archive of old recordings → L8
scenario.email.hint: Lock to 8 MB for typical attachment limits → L7
scenario.im.hint: Under 25 MB for file transfer → L6
scenario.offline.hint: Watch on a phone without Wi-Fi → L6
settings.engines.hint: Leave empty for the built-in lookup (next to the program, then the system PATH). Restart to apply.
settings.language.hint: Restart the app to apply the language change.
settings.preset.hint: Non-slow presets encode faster but produce larger files.
settings.priority.hint: Run ffmpeg with a lowered priority so foreground apps stay responsive.
settings.threads.hint: 0 means no limit; values above 0 cap the threads used for encoding.
